Note 6 (ticket 1):
  - employment type: contractor

  - comment: Security DB shows Traci Lowe (E041) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors are never admin; without advanced training they max out at read. Source Code is owned by the Engineer role, so admin is not permitted regardless. Requested admin exceeds the max of read; recommend read.
reason: Traci Lowe (E041) requested admin to Source Code, which is owned by the Engineer role — so admin is not permitted under any reading of the policy. There is conflicting evidence on employment status: most notes list her as a full-time Analyst (max write), but the Security DB note lists her as a contractor with basic security training, which caps her at read (contractors never get admin; write requires advanced training).
